pc_inositol.name: Myo-Inositol Complex
pc_inositol.key: 6 capsules: 3,902 mg myo‑inositol + 97 mg D‑chiro‑inositol (40:1), 200 mcg chromium, 500 mg fenugreek, 300 mg Ceylon cinnamon
pc_inositol.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Myo-Inositol Complex SS ND680' Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Myo-Inositol Complex SS ND680.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAzgNA), opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03; the same panel is in scratchpad labels/labels.json R279. Supplement Facts, serving 6 capsules, 30 servings: chromium (as chromium picolinate) 200 mcg (571% DV), myo-inositol 3,902 mg, fenugreek extract (seed) 500 mg, Ceylon cinnamon powder (bark) 300 mg, D-chiro-inositol 97 mg (3,902:97 = 40:1). Directions: 'Take six capsules daily in two divided doses'. Caution: 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Card claims, from the same sheet: 'Support healthy ovarian function', 'Support healthy menstrual cycles', 'Support optimal blood glucose balance'. Size 180C: ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26 (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA7UcQ). Dose bar: 3 capsules twice daily is the label's six a day in two doses and Monique Class's NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS protocol 'Myo-Inositol Complex: 3 BID' (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAly0w, via scratchpad wf/protocol-pcos.json). Asher offers it by name for PCOS patients (Gmail thread 1a0ba31792773b82, 2026-09-25). No verified product-page slug, so the link falls back to the nutridyn.com catalog search. Photo: only a 344x640 soft stopgap exists (img-src/R279.png, enlarged from an 86x160 chart thumbnail); the print master is still needed. Sheet-local key: replaces the old 'inositol' override, which no other sheet used.

pc_berberine.name: Berberine Pro
pc_berberine.key: Per capsule: 100 mg dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) + 84 mg organic Ceylon cinnamon extract
pc_berberine.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Berberine Pro SS ND1130' Rev. 11/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Berberine Pro SS ND1130.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA3OYw), opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 90 servings: dihydroberberine (GlucoVantage) 100 mg; organic cinnamon extract (bark; Cinnamomum ceylon) 84 mg. Directions: 'Take one capsule three times daily before meals'. Caution: 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Card claims, from the same sheet: 'Promotes healthy glucose metabolism', 'Supports heart health & optimal lipid balance'. Same facts in the products DB (R2125, DFH/Ortho/Thorne chart label reads of catalog ND143 10/1/26); size R2125 90C. Protocols: Monique Class NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS 'Berberine Pro: TID (depending on labs)' (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAly0w) and Kenneth Johnson GLC 2026 'PMOS (formerly PCOS)' 'Berberine Pro: 1 cap TID wf' (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA7hTA); the sheet prints the label timing. The rhythm keeps three doses, each before a meal (the dose bar says 'before meals'): 1 with the Morning box and 2 '(lunch, dinner)' with the Evening meal box, because the shared rhythm has no midday slot. URL: Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact (claude.ai/artifact/A433pRukpdQnwQkjArsBvF, HbA1c path) links https://nutridyn.com/berberine-pro. Photo img-src/R2125.png 856x1516.

pc_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
pc_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK‑7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
pc_d3_5000_k2.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382' Rev. 6/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAnbug), opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 softgel, 60 servings: vitamin D3 (as cholecalciferol) 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K1 (as phytonadione) 15 mcg, vitamin K2 as MK-7 (MenaQ7) 60 mcg. Directions: 'Take one softgel daily with food'. Warnings printed on the label: 'Use should be short-term and include regular monitoring of 25-(OH)- and 1,25-(OH)2-vitamin D levels. This product contains vitamin D at a level that exceeds the adult tolerable upper intake level.' and 'Vitamin K2 may counteract the effects of anticoagulation therapy and is not recommended for patients on blood-thinning medications.' (hence 'check your vitamin D level' on the dose bar and the rx notes). Card claims from the same sheet: 'Supports healthy mood and stress levels', 'Supports bone and skin tissues', 'Supports immune function'; 'Supports healthy vitamin D levels' paraphrases its 'help ensure users obtain adequate amounts'. Same amounts in the products DB R197 (catalog ND143 10/1/26), size 60S. Protocol: Monique Class NutriDyn GLC 2023 PCOS 'Vit D3 5000 IU'. URL slug from products.py SLUGS, also linked in Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact. Photo img-src/R197.png 876x1508.

pc_omega.name: Omega Pure EPA‑DHA 1000
pc_omega.key: Per softgel: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA)
pc_omega.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416' Rev. 4/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAyHow), opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 softgel, 120 servings: total omega-3 fatty acids 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3 100 mg; contains fish (anchovy, sardine, mackerel). Directions: 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food'. Card claims from the same sheet: 'Healthy cardiovascular function', 'Healthy immune function', 'Skin vitality'. The triglyceride bullet is the series' structure/function wording for this product (insulin-resistance sheet), qualified 'already in a normal range'; it is not printed on ND416. Same amounts in the products DB R243. Protocols: Kenneth Johnson GLC 2026 'PMOS' 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000: 2 softgels BID wf for the triglycerides' and Monique Class GLC 2023 'Fish oils: 2 BID' (4 a day, above the label's 3); the sheet prints 2 a day with food, inside the label. URL slug from products.py SLUGS, also linked in Asher's 'Own Every Protocol' artifact. No-break hyphen and space so the name breaks only as 'Omega Pure / EPA-DHA 1000' (kit.print_safe prints a plain hyphen). Photo img-src/R243.png 848x1552.

pc_ultrabiotic.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi‑Strain
pc_ultrabiotic.key: 30 billion CFU, 7 strains: 4 Lactobacillus, B. lactis, Bacillus coagulans, S. boulardii
pc_ultrabiotic.src: Label: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460' Rev. 7/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAlbgg), opened with the Dropbox fetch tool 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts, serving 1 capsule, 30/60 servings, CFU at time of manufacture: Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion, Lactobacillus reuteri (LRC) 5 billion, Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, Lactobacillus plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 at 4.167 billion each = 30 billion. Directions: 'Take one capsule daily'. Card claims from the same sheet: 'Support a healthy gut microbiome' and, in its text, 'promote healthy hormone functions'. Sizes: products DB R829 30C and R829L 60C (ND144 10/1/26). Dose and timing: Asher's PCOS patient handout (repo handouts/pcos-probiotic-patient-handout.pdf): 'Daily Dose: 1 capsule', 'Best Time: With a meal, same time each day', 'Give it 12 weeks before you judge it'. URL: Asher's PCOS blast (repo blasts/pcos-probiotic.html) and products.py SLUGS. The serving line groups the strains: L. reuteri, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus and L. gasseri are the 4 Lactobacillus; B. lactis is Bifidobacterium, and Bacillus coagulans is spelled out so the two B. genera cannot be confused. Taken with breakfast (Morning box), per the handout's 'with a meal'. No-break hyphen keeps 'Multi-Strain' whole. Photo img-src/R829.png 736x1356.
